flowbridge.intro: A complete front-end concept for presenting a workflow product clearly—built to explore the interface, interactions and responsive storytelling.

features.title: Guided workflow demo
features.description: Step through illustrative Submit, Review and Approve states inside the page.

features.title: Keyboard interaction
features.description: Arrow-key controls and visible focus make the workflow demo easier to use.

features.title: Demo form states
features.description: Client-side validation for the sample form; no messages are sent or stored.

features.title: Responsive navigation
features.description: Functional mobile menu and layouts tested across six screen widths.

features.title: Editorial art direction
features.description: Distinctive typography and page composition built around the product story.

features.title: Simple source structure
features.description: Standalone HTML, CSS and JavaScript without an application build system.

flowbridge.quickStart: Extract the ZIP and open index.html in a browser. Edit the HTML, CSS and JavaScript to make the demo your own.
flowbridge.limitation: Fictional product. The form, workflow and accounts are visual simulations only; no backend, external integrations or real customer data.

roomflow.intro: A functional room-booking admin dashboard concept designed around real interaction challenges: dense tables, role-specific controls and responsive workflows.

features.title: Booking management
features.description: Create sample bookings with required-field and duplicate-time validation.

features.title: Room search and filters
features.description: Browse room requests with live filtering, empty states and reset controls.

features.title: Role-aware interface
features.description: Switch between front-desk and manager UI states to explore permissions.

features.title: Confirmation states
features.description: Sample deletion, cancellation and confirmation flows built into the UI.

features.title: Responsive data tables
features.description: Dense operational data stays scrollable inside the table, including on mobile.

features.title: Mobile navigation
features.description: Adapted sidebar and controls for narrow dashboards.

roomflow.quickStart: Extract the ZIP and open index.html. Use the sample data and interface states to explore booking workflows locally.
roomflow.limitation: All room, clinic and booking information is fictional. Role restrictions and booking validation are front-end demonstrations, not secure server-side enforcement.

orbitdesk.intro: A playful yet functional product landing page that combines strong visual storytelling with a sample creative-team task workspace.

features.title: Working task board
features.description: Explore illustrative work items using a compact board interface.

features.title: Board and list views
features.description: Switch perspectives without losing task-stage changes.

features.title: Editable demo stages
features.description: Change a sample task's stage and see the UI stay synchronized.

features.title: Add-note dialog
features.description: Create a local demo note with required-title validation and focus restoration.

features.title: Accessible interactions
features.description: Functional mobile menu, FAQ and keyboard-aware controls.

features.title: Expressive visual identity
features.description: A tactile, editorial-style marketing interface with responsive layouts.

orbitdesk.quickStart: Extract the ZIP and open index.html. Explore the sample tasks and adjust HTML, styles and JavaScript locally.
orbitdesk.limitation: Illustrative product and sample tasks only. No user accounts, persistent task storage, workspace API, or third-party integrations.

margin-magazine.intro: An independent literary journal concept with original illustration, expressive editorial typography and functional reading interactions.

features.title: Distinctive editorial identity
features.description: Warm paper tones, large serif typography and custom visual compositions.

features.title: Original artwork
features.description: Six bundled SVG assets, including story art and the magazine's visual collage.

features.title: Browse by genre
features.description: Filter four sample stories by Fiction, Poetry and Essays.

features.title: Reading dialogs
features.description: Open sample story excerpts in accessible reading dialogs with Escape support.

features.title: Writer information
features.description: A sample submissions information dialog, without collecting actual entries.

features.title: Newsletter validation
features.description: Functional local-only form feedback. No email is transmitted or stored.

margin-magazine.extraFiles: 6 SVG artwork assets and the original QA test files are included in the ZIP.
margin-magazine.quickStart: Extract the ZIP and open margin-magazine/index.html. All six SVG artworks are bundled locally.
margin-magazine.limitation: Fictional publication and sample stories. No real CMS, accounts, subscriptions, submissions processing or newsletter backend.
